external_deps: Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity or Muse Code)

review.tagline: Desktop, mobile and CLI client that runs many coding agents in parallel worktrees
review.summary: Paseo runs a local daemon that manages Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity and Muse Code agents, with Electron desktop, Expo mobile/web and CLI clients connecting to it. Each agent can run in its own git worktree, with an editor, terminals, diffs, pull requests and a built-in browser in one window. It also has a plugin system, a TypeScript SDK and orchestration skills.
review.audience: Developers running several coding agents in parallel from desktop, phone, CLI
strengths: One interface across seven agent CLIs, switchable per task
Per-agent git worktrees allow parallel runs on one or several machines
Same app on iOS, Android, desktop, web and CLI, plus a TypeScript SDK
No telemetry, tracking or forced log-in stated
weaknesses: Requires at least one agent CLI installed and configured with your own credentials
Plugins run with access to the daemon machine; trust is on the user
Docker image needs extending with the agent CLIs you use
Maintained by a single person, per the README
needs: Needs Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity or Muse Code), Node.js/npm for CLI install, Git
Models: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Pi
